scope summary: 29-page, machine-focused parent guideline for setting up a condition-monitoring programme: procedure overview, cost-benefit justification, asset audit/criticality, reliability and failure modes, measurement selection, data acquisition/analysis, alarm criteria, diagnosis/prognosis, reporting and programme review.
overlap: Strong conceptual overlap with existing B1/B2 SAMCO SHM guidance and D1/D2 value/statistical-pattern frameworks. Its scope is all machines, not civil structures or bridges; bridge-specific sensor placement, environmental normalization and structural limit states are outside scope.
recommendation: LOW — defer purchase; use lawful preview and existing SHM sources unless the architecture must formally claim ISO 17359 conformance or cover rotating/mechanical bridge assets.
rationale: Useful as a generic closed-loop condition-monitoring lifecycle, but marginal incremental value for a Hanoi bridge SHM architecture. The preview exposes enough structure to decide that B13, C5 Part 3, and selected TCVN 11823 parts are more project-specific.
